patch.value: i18n plumbing + German locale for package-owned UI strings

Add i18n plumbing (locale catalogs + t() helper + locale resolution + language selector) and a complete German (de) locale for all package-owned UI strings in the pm-web SPA. Part of epic pm-cli-website-m1ut (German localization).

Flat JSON catalogs (en.json + de.json) cover all package-owned UI strings: auth screen, nav, banners, settings incl. registration acknowledgement, consent UI; Tiny typed t(key, params?) helper with en fallback; locale resolution localStorage.pmLocale -> navigator.language prefix match -> en; Language selector (en/Deutsch) in settings view persists choice and sets document.documentElement.lang dynamically; Dates use active locale (de-DE when de) instead of hard-coded en-US; Server API error strings stay English on the wire; translate at display layer mapping known errors to catalog keys (fallback: raw message); Legal-page localization documented as overlay-owned (operator concern); German disclaimer string present; selector does not promise translated legal pages; German translations complete and natural (Sie-Form); no visible English when de active for package-owned strings; Unit tests: locale resolution order, t() fallback + params, catalog parity (every de key exists for every en key); Functional check: auth screen renders German when localStorage.pmLocale=de

value.author: pi-agent
value.text:
Implementation summary (i18n plumbing + German locale for package-owned UI strings):

- Added public/src/i18n/ with en.json + de.json flat dotted-key catalogs covering all package-owned UI strings (auth screen, nav, banners, cookie-consent banner, settings incl. registration acknowledgement + language selector) plus API/OIDC error messages (mapped at the display layer) and a German legal-adjacent disclaimer string.
- Added public/src/i18n.ts: typed t(key, params?) helper with en fallback, locale resolution (localStorage.pmLocale -> navigator.language prefix match -> en), async catalog loading via fetch, DOM binding via data-i18n/data-i18n-html/data-i18n-title/data-i18n-placeholder/data-i18n-aria attributes, document.documentElement.lang sync, translateError() display-layer mapping (fallback: raw message), and localeDate() (de-DE when de) replacing hard-coded en-US.
- index.html: added data-i18n wiring to the auth screen, nav/top-bar, offline/install banners, and cookie-consent banner; added an inline head script to set <html lang> from localStorage.pmLocale before first paint.
- auth.ts + settings.ts: replaced hard-coded English strings with t() calls; settings now uses localeDate() for the account-created date and exposes an en/Deutsch language selector that persists the choice and re-applies translations; API errors flow through translateError().
- sw.ts: added /src/i18n.js, /src/i18n/en.json, /src/i18n/de.json to the service-worker precache list.
- src/app.ts: documented that legal-page localization is overlay-owned (operator concern via PM_WEB_LEGAL_DIR) — the standalone legal HTML does not load the SPA bundle so the SPA t()/catalog plumbing cannot reach it; the language selector deliberately does not promise translated legal pages (see settings.languageHint), and a German disclaimer string (legal.disclaimer) is provided for translated legal-adjacent UI.

Tests added (test/i18n.test.ts): catalog parity (every en key exists in de, non-empty; no extra de keys; de differs from en for non-structural strings), locale resolution order (storage -> navigator prefix -> en; null skips a source), t()/translate fallback + {param} substitution, error.* English-value uniqueness for an unambiguous reverse map, translateError unknown-message passthrough, and a functional check simulating applyTranslations on the auth-screen block with the de catalog asserting no English auth strings remain.

Quality gates: npm run typecheck, npm run build, npm test (100 passing incl. new i18n tests), npm run audit:prod, npm run pack:dry-run, and npm run changelog:check all green. German uses Sie-Form throughout.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text:
CodeRabbit review fixes (PR #43, branch feat/i18n-de-locale) — all 5 findings addressed, no suppressions:

1. **index.html first-paint hint (navigator.language negotiation):** The inline head script now falls back to the browser language when no valid `pmLocale` is stored, mirroring `resolveLocale()` by recognizing German-prefixed `navigator.language` values (e.g. `de-DE`) as `de`. A first visit with a German browser no longer flashes `lang="en"`. Persisted de/en preference precedence and existing error handling are preserved.

2. **index.html accessible names (a11y):** Added `data-i18n-aria="nav.theme.title"` to the theme toggle and `data-i18n-aria="nav.settings"` to the settings button so their `aria-label` values update with the selected language for German screen-reader users (reusing existing translation keys).

3. **i18n.ts resilient localStorage:** Wrapped ALL localStorage access in try/catch — resolving the storage reference (`safeLocalStorage`), `getItem()` in `resolveLocale`, and `setItem()` in `setLocale`. A `SecurityError` (privacy/incognito mode) is now swallowed and startup continues with the existing locale fallback instead of rejecting `initI18n()`/`setLocale()` and preventing rendering.

4. **i18n.ts stale-fetch guard:** Added a monotonically increasing `localeReqId`; each `setLocale` invocation records its id and, after every awaited catalog fetch, verifies it is still the latest before committing any state (`enCatalog`, `activeCatalog`, `initialized`, `syncHtmlLang`, `applyTranslations`). The fetched catalog is captured in a local before the guard check, so a slow earlier German fetch finishing after a newer `en` selection is discarded and can never overwrite the active catalog. Stale requests return without applying.

5. **settings.ts localized confirmDialog buttons:** Extended the shared `confirmDialog()` API with an optional `labels?: { cancel?, confirm? }` parameter (defaults preserve the existing English "Cancel"/"Delete"/"Confirm" behavior, so other callers are unaffected). The GitHub token-clear flow now passes `t('dialog.cancel')` / `t('dialog.confirm')` via new catalog keys `dialog.cancel` / `dialog.confirm` / `dialog.delete` (en + de) so the German token-clear dialog is fully localized.

Tests added/extended (test/i18n.test.ts): first-paint hint navigator negotiation (runs the inline script against fakes), throwing `storage.getItem` fallback, throwing `safeLocalStorage` getter no-abort, throwing `storage.setItem` no-abort on `setLocale`, stale catalog fetch discarded when a newer `setLocale` wins, and `dialog.*` catalog-key parity/localization. Catalog parity + "every wired data-i18n key has a de translation" checks still green (covers the new `data-i18n-aria` bindings and `dialog.*` keys).

Quality gates: `npm run typecheck`, `npm run build`, `npm test` (106 passing, +6 i18n), `npm run changelog:check` — all green. German uses Sie-Form throughout.
